gap: In the Repeats section, a number field the person has cleared comes back with the OLD stored value, caret in front, as soon as they use another control in the section. The next digit they type is put in front of the old value, and that is what gets saved. SEED (desktop 1200x800, America/New_York, clock Tue 2026-03-10 09:00, lists as in recur-check): things-todos=[{id:'t1',title:'Water plants',project:'p_house',when:'2026-03-10',repeat:{mode:'completion',every:2,unit:'day'}}], route #/project/p_house. STEPS (one tab): (1) double-click the row, then click the card's repeat chip; the When picker opens on 'After Completion, Every [2] [days]'. (2) Click in the Every field, End, Backspace; the field is empty. (3) Click the unit button and pick 'weeks'. (4) Type 3. (5) Escape twice, then tick the row. EXPECTED: the rule the person entered, {mode:'completion',every:3,unit:'week'}, with the next occurrence on 2026-03-31. CONTRACT: 'Rule and reminder changes commit as they're made'; a break includes 'something the user typed lost'. CONTROL: typing 3 before picking weeks gives exactly that (control-type-then-unit.mjs). ACTUAL (2/2 clean runs, no page errors): picking 'weeks' redraws the section and puts '2' back in the emptied field, focused, caret at 0. The typed 3 lands in front, so the field reads '32' and the note says 'Next: Tue, Oct 20'. Storage has repeat {mode:'completion',every:32,unit:'week'}, and ticking creates the next occurrence on 2026-10-20 instead of 2026-03-31, so the to-do vanishes for 7 months. SAME WITH THE ENDS COUNT (2/2): Weekly on Tue with ends.after 10. Clear the 10, tick Fri, type 3, and storage gets ends {after:310}: a series meant to run 3 times now runs 310. CAUSE: repeat.js's input handler never saves a blank or 0 field. Any non-quiet save (unit menu, weekday, monthly radio or menus) calls render(), which rebuilds the fields from the stored rule and restores the blank field's caret [0,0]. Another tab changing the same to-do's date or reminder does the same (the r7 note). Repro: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-pr-Desktop-dev-Todo/7de92c54-84d7-47b2-acf0-63c627b2ff05/scratchpad/recur-r9-c3/repro-repeats-cleared-number-comes-back.mjs. ALSO TRIED, no break: store.js complete/reopen/contentKey/removeHeading/clearCompleted read line by line; spawnKey stays stable through reload, Delete Heading, Move and Clear completed; two-tab card, picker and Complete All paths. SEEN, NOT CLAIMED: (a) Backspace with a card open and focus on a card button (Tab to 'Clear deadline' x), or with nothing focused on a touch device with a keyboard, deletes that to-do, so the open next occurrence goes and the series ends (b2.mjs, t1.mjs). (b) The When picker on a just-completed occurrence still offers the rule, 'Next: ...' and Stop Repeating, but edits there only reach the dead copy, not the live next occurrence.
why: Repeats picker: a cleared Every/Ends number is redrawn with the old value in front of the caret, so typing 3 saves every 32 weeks (next one Oct 20, not Mar 31) or ends after 310, not 3
